name: Football-Era-Draft
description: Football draft game across eight decades: build a fifteen-player squad under a salary cap and play domestic leagues, cups and transfer windows.

paragraphs: Football Era Draft is a draft game about building a team across generations. Maradona's Napoli card can play alongside Messi's Barcelona card, but you still have to find a goalkeeper, fill your chosen formation, leave four useful substitutes on the bench and stay inside a salary cap that allows only two S-tier stars. Your fifteen then take your chosen club's place in its real domestic league for the available seasons of the decade, with cup races, transfer windows and a board that rewards or punishes your results.
Play in your browser. The game uses bundled data and needs no account, API key, package installation or separate source downloads.
